acv.quote: The account was worth about three hundred and twenty K a year.

header.reason: Lost the international half to Adyen, which tested Stefan's own traffic by country while we sent averages. Elena says nothing could be done, but our late analysis found fixable issues.

findings.label: What started it
findings.finding: Lead with declines by country in international markets.
findings.why: Stefan, the new head of payments, started by pulling declines by country, and some international markets looked bad.
findings.quote: the first thing he did was pull declines by country

findings.label: Who decided
findings.finding: Give the payments lead a number his CFO will accept.
findings.why: Stefan recommended the switch and the CFO approved it, so Stefan needed figures he could defend to the CFO.
findings.quote: I can't take an average to my CFO.

findings.label: The competitor
findings.finding: Add a clear answer to 'local acquiring' for international markets.
findings.why: Adyen tested part of Stefan's international traffic by country. Elena never saw the results and had no answer.

findings.label: Our message
findings.finding: Stop leading with average uplift. Lead with the customer's own rates.

line.text: Authorization Boost increases acceptance rates by 3.8% on average

findings.why: The average uplift number got silence, and Stefan asked for his own numbers instead.

findings.label: Missing proof
findings.finding: Name the person who reviews their approval numbers every month.

line.text: Premium support: a dedicated support manager who has ongoing context about your business

findings.why: Stefan asked who at Stripe watches his numbers monthly, and Elena had no name to give.
findings.quote: who at Stripe looks at his numbers every month, and I didn't have a name

findings.label: Their words
findings.finding: Say 'approvals' and 'money left on the table', not 'authorization' and 'uplift'.

line.text: Authorization Boost increases acceptance rates by 3.8% on average

findings.why: Stefan framed the problem as lost money and says 'approvals', not our word 'authorization'.
